title: TomWarps
description: High-performance warp system with customizable countdowns, action bar timers, and beautiful portal particles.
body:
# 🌀 TomWarps v1.0

A lightweight, modern, and high-performance teleportation plugin for Paper/Spigot servers. **TomWarps** provides a seamless experience for players to set warps, return to spawn, and go back to their previous locations with beautiful visual effects.

## ✨ Features

* 📍 **Warp System:** Create and manage custom warp points with ease.
* 🏠 **Spawn Command:** Global spawn teleportation that works across all world
* 🔙 **Back Command:** Return to your last location or your exact death point.
* ⚔️ **AntiCombat Feture:** You have to stand still to successfully teleport
* 🎨 **MiniMessage Support:** Fully customizable messages with RGB and gradients.
* 🔄 **Auto-Updates:** Integrated update checker via Modrinth API.
* 📊 **Statistics:** Plugin metrics powered by bStats.

---

## 🛠 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| /warp <name> | Teleport to a warp location | tomwarps.use |
| /spawn | Teleport to the world spawn | tomwarps.use |
| /back | Return to your last location | tomwarps.back |
| /warps | List all available warps | tomwarps.use |
| /setwarp <name> | Create a new warp point | tomwarps.admin |
| /delwarp <name> | Delete an existing warp | tomwarps.admin |
| /tomwarps reload| Reload the configuration | tomwarps.admin |

> **Note:** Players with tomwarps.bypass can teleport instantly without a countdown.

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the latest TomWarps.jar.
2. Place the jar file into your server's plugins folder.
3. Restart your server to generate the configuration.
4. Customize the config.yml to your liking and enjoy!
